name: Aura of Sublime Dread
body:
School necromancy [emotion]; Level cleric/oracle 9, psychic 9
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as aura of dread, save that your enemies who enter the area do not receive a saving throw against its effects, and spell resistance has no effect against it.
